name: nerviz
description: Delivery vehicle for Nerviz, an agent harness for Spring Boot: one skill that installs its norms, development skills, agents and hooks into an existing Java project and updates them later, one that takes a project on an older Spring Boot line up to the one it requires, and one that fetches the source to create a new project without a clone.

plugins.name: nerviz
plugins.description: Install or update the Nerviz `.claude/` inside a Java project — norms with globs derived for the project's own packages, development skills, agents, and the enforcement hook — take a project on an older Spring Boot line up to the one the architecture requires, or fetch the source to create a new project without a clone.
